inventory_rationale: State 6 freezes every accepted State 5 public operation, exactly one canonical boundary handler for each externally exposed operation, and the app-factory, credential-extractor, and principal-resolver seams required by deterministic Router Context. ChatGPT handlers belong to chatgpt_interaction, browser handlers to web_gateway, and local synchronization handlers to sync_gateway. No persistence adapter or implementation-private helper is invented before its later deterministic closure; reopen this inventory only when accepted evidence proves another stable callable seam is required.
